variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ossian at the Drowned Lantern, Dunstan the smith (mentions the shut gate), Mabry the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: Come in out of the wet! The Drowned Lantern has dry beds and the best eel stew on the Bracken. What'll it be?

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: Steel costs dear since the north gate shut. Swords, shields, mail... buy now, before the price climbs again.

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: Mabry's potions cure what ails you! Mostly. Scrolls and spell books are on the back shelf.

variants.specifics: Cave town of miners under a mountain: Hilde at the Deep Kettle, Torvald the armourer, Nessa the potion seller. No trouble mentioned.

inn.speaker: Hilde
inn.text: Mind your head on the beam -- everyone hits it once! Welcome to the Deep Kettle. Hot mushroom stew, two gold a bowl.

arms.speaker: Torvald
arms.text: Picks are for digging. If it's fighting you want, lad, I've axes and iron helms forged right here under the mountain.

magic.speaker: Nessa
magic.text: Scrolls of light, potions, spell books... all kept dry, and that's no small thing this deep. What do you need?

variants.specifics: Swamp hamlet on stilts: Tilly keeps the inn, Fenwick sells spears, Granny Reed sells potions (mentions the swamp fever).

inn.speaker: Tilly
inn.text: Wipe yer feet, the floor's only planks! Hot frog pie and a hammock up out of the damp. Staying?

arms.speaker: Fenwick
arms.text: Spears, mostly. Long ones. A short blade's no use against something that stays in the water. Have a look.

magic.speaker: Granny Reed
magic.text: Half the hamlet's down with swamp fever. Cure potions are by the door, and I'd thank you to leave me one!

variants.specifics: Castle town with a garrison: Bertram's tavern splits soldiers from travellers, Hagen the armourer boasts of the Captain's inspection, Ilse sells scrolls. No trouble mentioned.

inn.speaker: Bertram
inn.text: Soldiers drink on the left, travellers on the right. Keep it that way and we'll get on. Will you want a room?

arms.speaker: Hagen
arms.text: Good day to you! Every blade on this wall has passed the Captain's own inspection. You will find none finer outside the armoury.

magic.speaker: Ilse
magic.text: A visitor who isn't in uniform! How refreshing. Do browse -- the scrolls came in from the capital only yesterday.

variants.specifics: Lake village of fishermen: Dorran's Leaky Boat serves only fish, Sigrid sells harpoons, Pell sells potions (mentions the missing boats).

inn.speaker: Dorran
inn.text: Fish soup, fish pie, or fried fish. That's the menu at the Leaky Boat, so don't ask for mutton.

arms.speaker: Sigrid
arms.text: Ho there! Harpoons, spears, a few swords off the trading barge. Fair prices, and I'll hear no haggling.

magic.speaker: Pell
magic.text: Red potions sell fast since the boats started going missing. Better buy while I've a few left!

variants.specifics: Wizards' college town: Fenn's Inkpot hushes for the students, Rodric the lonely sword seller, Master Corvane sells the college's scrolls. No trouble mentioned.

inn.speaker: Fenn
inn.text: Shhh! The students upstairs are studying. Or sleeping. Bed and supper at the Inkpot -- and no singing.

arms.speaker: Rodric
arms.text: A customer! For a sword! Do you know how long it's been? Everyone in this town just waves their hands at things.

magic.speaker: Corvane
magic.text: Greetings, seeker. Every scroll on these shelves was copied by the college's own scribes. Choose with care, for I do not take returns.

variants.specifics: Frozen fort on a mountain pass: Ma Gruen's cookhouse, Ottar the shield seller (mentions the wolves on the pass), Yselde who keeps potions by the fire.

inn.speaker: Ma Gruen
inn.text: Shut the door! Shut it! ...There. Hot broth and a blanket, or did you only come in to let the cold through?

arms.speaker: Ottar
arms.text: Wolves on the pass, and worse above the snowline. Get yourself a stout shield before you go up. I have three.

magic.speaker: Yselde
magic.text: Everything freezes up here, even the potions. I keep mine by the fire. Warm one, four gold?

variants.specifics: Lava-forge town of smiths: Ragna's alehouse in the heat, Master Holt with blades still hot from the pits, Saffi with burn potions. No trouble mentioned.

inn.speaker: Ragna
inn.text: Ale! Ale and water, and in this heat you'll want both. Sit anywhere that isn't smoking.

arms.speaker: Holt
arms.text: Hammered in the fire-pits, quenched in the black spring! No harder steel exists in the land. Don't touch the red ones.

magic.speaker: Saffi
magic.text: Welcome, welcome. Potions against burns, scrolls, a few old spell books. Ask if you don't see it.

variants.specifics: Crossroads inn and its hamlet: Barnaby of the Four Ways, Lukas the pedlar of shields (mentions highwaymen on the east road), Wynn with spell books under the counter.

inn.speaker: Barnaby
inn.text: Travellers off all four roads stop at the Four Ways, and every one leaves happy! Bed, board, or both, kind sir?

arms.speaker: Lukas
arms.text: Highwaymen on the east road again. A shield costs less than a funeral, friend. Want to see one?

magic.speaker: Wynn
magic.text: Psst... you there. You look like someone who reads. I've spell books nobody else in this hamlet would buy.

variants.specifics: Farming town troubled by Ogres: Hob feeds travellers, Gerda sells axes (mentions last night's Ogre raid), Old Maudie sells potions and an unread spell book.

inn.speaker: Hob
inn.text: Cider from our own orchard, bread from our own wheat. Sit down and eat, you look half-starved!

arms.speaker: Gerda
arms.text: Ogres again last night -- took two pigs! You'll want an axe, and a big one. I have just the thing.

magic.speaker: Maudie
magic.text: Hello, dearie! Potions for the belly, potions for the head, and a spell book my husband never opened. Care to see?
